segments.text: This episode takes place on Phil’s birthday, which is also the day the first iPad goes on sale. To Phil, this is basically a religious event.

segments.text: He plans to wake up early and wait outside the store, but Claire tells him not to spend his birthday in line. She promises she’ll get the iPad instead. The plan is sweet. The execution is terrible.

segments.text: Claire gets up early, sits down for a second, falls asleep on the couch, and wakes up too late. By the time she reaches the store, the iPads are gone.

segments.text: Phil tries to act like it doesn’t matter, but it obviously does. Claire feels awful because for once she was sure she had found the perfect gift. She gets the kids to help her look for one somewhere else.

segments.text: Phil goes to the batting cages to cheer himself up. He sees a birthday party and briefly thinks Claire has arranged a surprise for him. Then he realizes the party is for a little boy who is also named Phil. After that, he basically gives up on the day and goes home.

segments.text: Meanwhile, Jay gives Phil a chess set and tries it out with Manny. Jay assumes Manny barely knows how to play, so Gloria secretly tells Manny to let him win. Manny does, but Jay becomes unbearable, giving him advice and explaining basic moves like he’s teaching a child.

segments.text: Jay then plays Gloria, expecting to restore his pride. Gloria is much better than he thinks and reaches a position where she can clearly win. Instead of finishing, she stops and admits she often lets Jay win because he’s a terrible loser.

segments.text: At Mitchell and Cameron’s house, they hear a strange man’s voice through Lily’s baby monitor and think someone is inside. Cameron runs to Lily while Mitchell freezes. It turns out the monitor is picking up the neighbors.

segments.text: Cameron keeps listening and realizes the couple next door are about to break up over a misunderstanding. He goes over and clears it up, feeling like he saved their marriage. Then they realize he has been listening to their private conversations and start calling him a creep.
